mp_id.description: 13-digit Global Location Number of the trading partner

business_key.description: Business key: malo_id (GPKE/GeLi Gas), melo_id (WiM Strom), or vorgang_id (WiM Gas Stornierung)

ProcessView.description: One process under a business key, with the deadlines pending on it.

process_id.description: The process identifier within its workflow.

deadlines.description: The deadlines registered on the process's stream.

DeadlineView.description: One deadline pending on a process.

label.description: The label its workflow declares in `DEADLINE_LABELS`.

art.description:
`aperak` or `contrl` for a delivery window — the labels
`mako_fristen` owns — and `prozess` for every deadline the workflow
itself registered.

due_at.description: When the deadline fires, RFC 3339 in UTC.

business_key.description: The business key the caller passed.

processes.description:
The processes indexed under the key — concurrent ones (a Lieferbeginn
beside a Sperrung) and finished ones alike: the correlation index is
append-only, so whether a process is still running is its own state,
not the index's.

process_id.description: The process id, as `get_process` returns it.

HistoryEntry.description:
One recorded event. `richtung`, `pid` and `message_ref` are present when the
event is a market message, as its workflow states it — never derived from
`event_type`, which is an identifier.

recorded_at.description: When the event was recorded, RFC 3339 in UTC.

event_type.description: The workflow's name for the event.

antwortcode.description: DE 9013 — the code the answer gives (`A02`, `E15`, `Z12`, …).

codeliste.description:
DE 1131 — the Codeliste or Entscheidungsbaum that defines the code
(`E_0622`, `S_0090`).

bedeutung.description:
The BDEW's wording for the code in that list, from the catalogue.
`None` when the list does not publish the code — never another tree's
meaning.

eintraege.description: Every event of the process, in the order it was recorded.

rejected_at.description:
When it was rejected, RFC 3339 in UTC; `None` when the stored instant
cannot be read as one.

reason_detail.description: What went wrong, in the engine's words.

dead_letters.description: The most recent first, at most 20.

gesamt.description: Every dead letter the store holds — not the length of the page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-500, default 100)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous list_partners response

command.description:
Dotted command name in the format `<domain>.<prozess>.<aktion>`.

Use `list_commands` first to discover all available commands for this
instance. Examples: `gpke.lieferbeginn.anmelden`,
`wim.geraetewechsel.beauftragen`, `geli.lieferbeginn.anmelden`.

**Single-role commands** (e.g. `gpke.lieferbeginn.anmelden` → always
`LF`) do not need `marktrolle`. **Multi-role commands** (e.g.
`wim.geraetewechsel.beauftragen` → `NB` or `MSB`) require it.

marktrolle.description:
Marktrolle override — required only for multi-role commands.

Permitted values: `LF`, `LFG`, `NB`, `GNB`, `MSB`, `BKV`, `ÜNB`.
Omit for single-role commands.

payload.description:
Command-specific payload fields.

| Command | Required fields |
|---|---|
| `gpke.lieferbeginn.anmelden` | `malo_id` (11-digit), `lieferbeginn_datum` (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `gpke.lieferende.anmelden` | `malo_id`, `lieferende_datum`, `transaktionsgrund`, optional `transaktionsgrund_ergaenzung` (default: the MaLo's energy direction) |
| `gpke.kuendigung.anmelden` | `malo_id`, `kuendigung_datum`, `lfa_mp_id` (the Altlieferant) |
| `geli.lieferbeginn.anmelden` | `malo_id` (gas), `process_date` (YYYYMMDD), `transaktionsgrund`, `bilanzkreis`, `abrechnungsintervall_monate`, `haushaltskunde`, `netznutzungsvertrag`, `netznutzung_zahler`, `gemeinderabatt_prozent`, `kunde`, `ablesekarte` — `mako_markt::commands::GeliLieferbeginnAnmelden`, no other key |
| `geli.lieferende.anmelden` | `malo_id` (gas), `process_date` (YYYYMMDD), `transaktionsgrund` — `mako_markt::commands::GeliLieferendeAnmelden`, no other key |
| `geli.kuendigung.anmelden` | `malo_id` (gas), `process_date` (YYYYMMDD), `lfa_mp_id` (the Altlieferant) — `mako_markt::commands::GeliKuendigungAnmelden`, no other key |
| `wim.geraetewechsel.beauftragen` | `melo_id`, `process_date` (YYYYMMDD), `receiver_mp_id` |
| `mabis.abrechnung.einleiten` | `bilanzierungsgebiet`, `abrechnungszeitraum_von`, `abrechnungszeitraum_bis` |

idempotency_key.description:
Optional stable key identifying this business request.

Supply the same value on a retry and the recorded response is replayed
instead of the command running twice; the record lives for 24 hours.
Reusing one key for a different command or payload is refused. When
omitted a random UUID is echoed back and no replay record is kept.
